title: ECMWF Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS)
organization: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)
demonstrates: Demonstrates data-driven ML models achieving skill comparable to traditional HRES physics-based NWP systems at 1/10,000th computational cost during inference.
howUsed: ForecastBridge incorporates AIFS output as a primary AI model stream in short-to-medium range lead-time weighting matrices.

title: NOAA & NCAR AI for Weather & Climate Prediction
organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information / NCAR
demonstrates: Establishes hybrid physics-AI post-processing standards, quantile mapping for extreme precipitation, and ensemble uncertainty bounds.
howUsed: ForecastBridge applies NOAA/NCAR bias correction routines and quantile mapping logic in Stage 06 of the blending pipeline.

title: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Multi-Model Ensemble Framework
organization: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), Government of India
demonstrates: Provides operational Indian tropical monsoon climatology baselines, regional hazard thresholds for flash floods and heat waves, and district-level warning criteria.
howUsed: ForecastBridge uses IMD regional hazard criteria to trigger WATCH, ADVISORY, HIGH RISK, and EXTREME alerts.

title: Learning Skillful Medium-Range Weather Forecasting (GraphCast)
demonstrates: Proves graph neural networks trained on ERA5 reanalysis outperform top deterministic NWP models on 90%+ of atmospheric variables.
howUsed: ForecastBridge leverages GraphCast's mesoscale feature extraction concepts to detect weather regimes dynamically.
